title: Robert Pattinson Is Taking All the Jobs?
description: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond, and the internet thinks he's coming for everyone's job, Ryan's included. Maya explains how Bond is really cast, what Amazon paid for 007, and the economics of superstars: why one actor gets every big role, why stars don't guarantee hits, and why your job is probably safe.

seo.title: Robert Pattinson Is Taking All The Jobs?
seo.description: Robert Pattinson is now both Batman and James Bond, sparking fears about his impact on the industry and your job security. Economists explain how studios chase top talent at any cost, why this trend started in 1981, and whether one star can really replace human meetings.
